root.description: Absolute deterministic run storage root. At least the user or project layer must configure it; a run layer may not change it.

worker_profiles.description: Worker launch profiles, patched per layer by name. A profile inherits only from the same name in an earlier layer: a name no earlier layer defines must declare `role` in the layer that first defines it, or the layer is rejected with invalid_config. This cross-layer rule is enforced in code, not expressible here.

trigger.description: Optional prose naming when this route applies, rendered as advisory selection criteria beside the skill names.

profiles.description: Optional worker-profile scope. Present: the rule is delivered only to a lane whose assignment profile is named here. Absent: the rule reaches every profile. A name no worker_profiles entry defines never matches and is not an error, since rules and profiles may live in different layers. A delivery point with no profile in hand — every orchestrator-surface point — receives only unscoped rules.

rules.description: Advisory skill routes surfaced in tool results and worker dispatch prompts at matching boundaries. Routes never gate settlement, lifecycle, or authority.

guidance.description: Optional profile-selection criteria prose for this worker profile, delivered as advisory material at judgment boundaries. It never resolves a role, a model, or authority. Required nowhere; when a layer defines a profile name for the first time it must still declare `role` (code-enforced).
